_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `references` and `baselines` describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown). `new_design_reviewed`: the fingerprints (site/build.py `reviewed_hash`) of the README card's parts the page replaces with its own text, its opening and, with `new_design_checks`, its text on the commands, as last checked against the page; a README edit there warns (fatal under --strict) until the page is checked again.
title: N-bit multiplier
subtitle: The full 2N-bit product of two unsigned N-bit numbers, with logic gates only.

references.mul_n: The N × N array multiplier, partial products summed by rows of full adders, proved with the sv_comb tactics.
references.mul_n_byhand: The same design as `mul_n`, proved by hand without the tactics: the by-hand proof.
references.mul_tree: A log-depth carry-save tree of 4:2 compressors over the partial-product rows, with a ripple final adder.
references.mul_wallace: A Wallace tree: carry-save adders reduce the rows three at a time, then a ripple final adder.
references.mul_tree_h: A carry-save tree whose leaves each hold two partial-product rows, every node a 4:2 compressor, with a ripple final adder.

baselines.yosys_mul: Yosys's own multiplier, `assign p = a * b;`, which uses the banned `*`.
baselines.dadda_rc_8: A Dadda tree with a ripple final adder, generated for N = 8 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.dadda_rc_16: A Dadda tree with a ripple final adder, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.dadda_rc_32: A Dadda tree with a ripple final adder, generated for N = 32 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.dadda_ks_8: A Dadda tree with a Kogge-Stone final adder, generated for N = 8 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.dadda_ks_16: A Dadda tree with a Kogge-Stone final adder, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.dadda_ks_32: A Dadda tree with a Kogge-Stone final adder, generated for N = 32 only; not scored, because synthesis ran past the flow's time limit.
